title: Wastewater capacity insufficient with no mitigation
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-evidence-source-backlog-disposition.md (round 5) + ADR-0060 row wording; surfaces via migration 0032 — threshold by criterion wording (ADR-0060)
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: infra.wastewater_capacity_sufficient plus a mitigation flag (no infrastructure var). ADR-0068 arms this: infra.wastewater_insufficient_no_mitigation counts sites where wastewater capacity is insufficient AND no mitigation is documented; missing until at least one site has its wastewater assessment populated (ADR-0049). ADR-0160 (Proposed): scoped to greenfield plans with site_required = true (null sub-track by default; existing_business_rbd / intra_venture only when a human confirms a site). Not deleted; sub_track and site_required are seeded routing vars (migration 0136), but this criterion's scope stays a selection rule in greenfield-subtrack.ts — the count predicate cannot trip when no site is in scope. Out-of-scope handling (risk-officer review 2026-10-12): when a person confirms site_required = false, the site steps and the site assessment are out of scope, so this criterion stays 'unassessed' — it is not suppressed and is never read as passed. A person who confirms site_required = false for a project that builds or extends a plant takes responsibility for that confirmation.
